ausencia declarada no catalogo: A Data Action cannot declare input parameters: the Model API of IDataAction creates output parameters, local variables and nodes, and has no CreateInputParameter (same contract on ODC and O11).

ausencia declarada no catalogo: REST callbacks (consumed: OnBefore/OnAfterRequest[Advanced]; exposed: OnRequest/OnResponse on ODC) and the exposed-REST authentication flow have no job; the four consumed-callback creators are ambiguous for the generic create (the first assignable factory would win), and the authentication flow has no creator in either catalog.

ausencia declarada no catalogo: On ODC IRestClient.Username/Password accept writes but the Verify rejects them as errors; only the authentication mode (AuthenticationType/ClientAuthentication) stays in the model. Credentials are configured outside the model.

ausencia declarada no catalogo: ODC apps do not consume SOAP through this kernel: the op soap answers SOAP_LANE_UNSUPPORTED on ODC. An ODC binary declares SOAP consumption removed, while the ODC Studio still ships the SOAP plugin; no route is proven.
